relationships.subject: hand-held vibrating tool exposure
relationships.evidence_quote: Galanin levels were higher in the group reporting much vibration exposure compared with the group without vibration exposure (table 1).

relationships.subject: hand-held vibrating tool exposure
relationships.evidence_quote: No other differences among the other analysed biomarkers were observed.

key_findings: Plasma galanin was higher in individuals reporting much hand-held vibrating tool exposure (p=0.015), but not after adjustment for age, sex, smoking and diabetes.
VEGF-A, VEGF-D, VEGFR2, HSP27, NGF, TNF and other biomarkers did not differ with vibration exposure.
